folded: Nov 16, 2026: broken up. The Vision and Scarlet Witch becomes a commander. Ultron, Artificial Malevolence and Ultron, Machine Overlord to Doom Unrivaled. To Kang: Victor Timely, Iron Lad, Diverging Destiny, Wiccan, Rising Magician, Spaceshift, Silver Surfer, Cosmic Voyager, Arc Reactor, School Daze, Whoosh!, We Say Thee Nay!. To Captain America: Shield Throw: Tony Stark, Falcon's Wing Harness, Thirst for Knowledge. To King T'Challa: Rescue, Pepper Potts, Dismissive Denial. To The Vision and Scarlet Witch: Machine Man, Crimson Operative, Hex Magic, Death to Our Enemies. Iron Man Armor is a spare.
name: Tony Stark: Stark Industries
notes: Tony Stark comes down on turn two and digs for an artifact every turn. At six mana he becomes The Invincible Iron Man, a hasty 5/5 flier that drops an artifact from your hand every combat. The Jumpstart Iron Man packet adds Iron Man, Bleeding Edge (copy an artifact spell each turn), Rescue and Iron Lad.
Turns 1–3: Tony Stark, then Shuri, Iron Lad or Hydraulic Helper; Iron Suitcase and Collector's Case are cheap artifacts for Tony to find.

Turns 4–6: Iron Man, Bleeding Edge copies your best artifact each turn; Machinesmith Automaton, Machine Man and HYDRA Assault Robot grow or ping with every arrival. Silver Surfer and Rescue replay your enters-the-battlefield artifacts. Reed Richards turns your extra draws into four cards each.
Closing: Transform Tony and put Equipment straight onto him each combat. The Thanos-Copter and Iron Man, Master of Machines add flying damage, and Team Tactics gives a big flier double strike.

Bracket 2: No combos or extra turns. Dismissive Denial is the one hard counter. Ultron, Artificial Malevolence pays {2} to copy every nontoken artifact you play, and noncreature copies become 2/2 Robots, which Ultron, Machine Overlord pumps by +2/+2 along with the deck's other Robots. Vision Quest finds Ultron or Iron Man, Bleeding Edge straight from your library or graveyard (it's the deck's one tutor), and Armor Wars draws a card per artifact before hitting an opponent for your biggest one. Arc Reactor ramps you to Tony's transform turn, Iron Man Armor becomes a flier with +1/+1 per artifact you control, and The Ten Rings refills your hand to ten every end step. Mjölnir lives in the Miles deck; Ironheart is the only other rare worth chasing.

Set tags: MSH = Marvel Super Heroes, SPM = Marvel's Spider-Man, MSC = Marvel Super Heroes Commander and Jumpstart cards. Every card listed is one you own. Hot Dog Cart and Dependable Quinjet are in all five Marvel B2 decks; some other commons and uncommons are shared too.

notes: Nov 15 generic sim: Futurist Forge and Daily Bugle Newspaper were the two lowest cards in the deck. Rocks are artifacts Tony can still find, and they speed the six-mana transform.

Honest caveat: the bigger tested package (four rocks, four dual lands) added 0.45 mana on turn 4 and no win rate (20.9% to 20.6%). Tony costs two, so rocks do not bring him down sooner. Treat this as a small tidy-up, not a fix.
